kf1.ect: dinámico = innovación con pesos prior (ỹ_t); estático = β̃ᵀ ln P_t − c con Johansen de train

kf2.model: estado aumentado: mu_t = mu_{t-1} + w (q_mu); x_t = phi x_{t-1} + w (q_x); ECT_t = mu_t + x_t + v (r)
kf2.init: mu0 = 0, x0 = 0, P0 = diag(q_x / (1 - phi^2), q_x / (1 - phi^2)); arranca tras el burn-in del filtro 1
kf2.zscore: z_t = (ECT_t - mu_prior) / sigma_prior, sigma_prior^2 = q_x / (1 - phi^2) + p_mu_prior + r
